SwimSession.title: SwimSession
SwimSession.description: A recorded swimming session containing distance, lap count, duration, pace from Apple Watch, and additional metrics.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the swimmer.

date.description: Date of the workout in YYYY-MM-DD format.

poolLength.description: Length of the swimming pool in meters (e.g. 25 or 50).

distance.description: Total distance swum in meters (laps * poolLength).

durationSeconds.description: Total active swimming duration in seconds.

stroke.description: Primary swimming stroke (e.g., kraul, grzbiet, klasyczny, motylkowy, zmienny, mieszany).

avgHeartRate.description: Average heart rate in BPM recorded by Apple Watch.

maxHeartRate.description: Maximum heart rate in BPM recorded by Apple Watch.

poolName.description: Name or location of the swimming facility.

source.description: Source of workout entry (e.g. apple_watch, manual).

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the record was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the record was last modified.

UserSettings.title: UserSettings
UserSettings.description: User preferences for pool length, weekly targets, and theme.

defaultPoolLength.description: Default pool length in meters (e.g. 25 or 50).

weeklyGoalMeters.description: Weekly swimming distance target in meters.

themePreference.description: Theme choice: dark, light, or system.

/users/{userId}/sessions/{sessionId}.description: Collection of recorded swim sessions for a specific user.

/users/{userId}/settings/{settingsId}.description: User profile settings including default pool length and targets.
